issue.title: allow exceptions in middleware to surface when using TestClient

issue.body:
This test:

```
def test_middleware_run_during_statup():
    from starlette.applications import Starlette
    from starlette.middleware import Middleware

    called = []

    class SampleMiddleware:
        def __init__(self, app):
            self.app = app

        async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):
            called.append('called')
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)

    app = Starlette(
        middleware=[Middleware(SampleMiddleware)],
    )

    with TestClient(app):
        pass

    assert called == []
```

..fails as follows:
```
>       assert called == []
E       AssertionError: assert ['called'] == []
```

Why is the middleware being called before any requests have been issues to the test client?
issue.title: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable when middleware raises an exception.
allow exceptions in middleware to surface when using TestClient
